bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 14 × 14 inches and small bags up to 5 × 8 × 1 inches are permitted. Oversized bags and backpacks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: A garage on High Street next to Ohio State University’s Union is across from the Newport; check its posted rate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue’s directions and the operator FAQ do not specify a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available onsite; outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For general-admission accessible seating, contact Guest Services when you arrive.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Almost all PromoWest shows prohibit re-entry; ask staff before exiting about a particular concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Newport Will Call tickets are released at the door time at the box office; the box office opens at 10 a.m. on show days.

gates.summary: The time on the ticket is the door-opening time; live music generally begins about an hour later.
